GIN.note: The ministry's review names an AI roadmap, not a law or binding rule.

facts.fact: The ministry (MPTEN) reports that in 2025 a national AI roadmap 2026-2035 was validated and a three-phase strategy to master and regulate AI was adopted, with UNDP's AILA methodology.
The ministry (MPTEN) states that texts on personal data protection are in progress, a legal framework being developed.
facts.system: Textes sur la protection des données personnelles
